summary: Built template management feature with Redux state management: created template-service.js for Supabase CRUD operations, template-slice.js Redux slice with full state management (templates, loading, error, selectedTemplate), variable-picker.jsx with clickable variable buttons that insert {{variableName}} placeholders, template-form.jsx with name/channel/content inputs and live preview with highlighted variables, template-list.jsx displaying templates with channel badges and edit/delete actions, and template-manager.jsx as the parent orchestrator. Integrated into App.jsx as a new 'templates' tab in bottom navigation. Set up Redux store with Provider wrapper in main.jsx.
